name: Sun Cleric: Taking Vows raises Vow of Light's copied heal to 15% and its buff tooltip says so (#9780)
contract: Vow of Light 807547 heals the nearest ally (including a lone caster) for $807750s1% of direct healing it receives;
807750 effect 1 resolves to 10. Taking Vows 300331 reads 'Your Vow of Light now heals for an additional $s1%' and is
a SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 flat modifier of 5 on 807750 (sun-cleric-taking-vows measures the modified value). The copy
read 807750 without the caster, so the heal stayed at 10% and only the spellbook text showed 15%. The copied heal
505197 is physical-school magic with ignored caster and health modifiers, so it cannot crit and is never scaled.
Two solo Sun Clerics heal themselves with Greater Heal rank 11 (10965, 746-852 base) so integer truncation of the copy
stays below 0.0014 of the ratio; rank 1 healed only 34 and truncated a 3.4 copy to 3. The copy over the effective heal must be
0.10 without the talent and 0.15 with it. The buff tooltip, which renders $807750s1 without spell modifiers, is
streamed with the talent-adjusted value; rendered client text is outside the harness.

steps.label: Let login hooks and the patch stream settle
The existing description stream is captured
The buff tooltip adds Taking Vows when it is known
SETUP: control Vow of Light is active
SETUP: talented Vow of Light is active
Let the global cooldown from Vow of Light clear
SETUP: the control heal is large enough to resolve the ratio
SETUP: the talented heal is large enough to resolve the ratio
CONTROL: without Taking Vows the copy is 10% of the healing received
DISCRIMINATING: Taking Vows raises the copy to 15% of the healing received
